mapper.sql: id,space_id AS spaceId,owner_user_id AS ownerUserId,workflow_id AS workflowId,workflow_version_id AS workflowVersionId,run_id AS runId,event_watermark AS eventWatermark,question,answer,question_item AS questionItem,answer_item AS answerItem,data,sid,chat_id AS chatId,type,deleted,create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM paiflow_workflow_dialog WHERE space_id=#{space} AND workflow_id=#{workflow} AND owner_user_id=#{owner} AND type=#{type} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE paiflow_workflow_dialog SET deleted=1 WHERE space_id=#{space} AND workflow_id=#{workflow} AND owner_user_id=#{owner} AND type=#{type} AND deleted=0
